newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Hansapank in 100 mln DM loan.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Hansapank in 100 mln DM loan.

text.p: Largest Estonian bank Hansapank on Thursday said it is to sign a 100 million German mark syndicated loan on March 14.
Hansapank's fixed income head Erkki Raasukke said that the lead for the syndicate was Bank Gesellschaft Berlin and that 29 banks were in the syndicate.
Raasukki said that the loan was for three years and was set at 95 basis points over three month or six month DEM LIBOR.
"The signing will be on March 14 and the draw down can start immediately after," he told Reuters.
He said that half of the funds would be used for refinancing existing debt and that the rest would go to finance the bank's activities and extend its liabilities.
